access.denied: Your grants do not allow that. Looking at feeds needs feed:read, changing them feed:*.
access.title: Not allowed
feed.delete_confirm: Delete this feed? Its snapshot is removed from its directory publishers.
feed.deleted: Feed deleted, and its snapshot removed.
feed.edit_lede: What is published, how often, and where. Only what is listed here leaves the installation, and only labels, values, units and times.
feed.error.disabled: The feed is disabled: enable it to publish it.
feed.error.id: No id could be made for the feed; try again.
feed.error.interval: The refresh interval is a whole number of seconds, from 30 to 86400.
feed.error.publish: Publishing failed: the reason is under Last error.
feed.error.publisher: A publisher the feed names does not exist.
feed.error.save: The change could not be saved.
feed.error.title: A feed needs a title, of 120 characters at most.
feed.error.too_many: There are already as many feeds as Feed keeps.
feed.lede: Chosen readings of the installation, published outward as static snapshots and a widget script. Other sites read the files a publisher put somewhere; nothing reaches the installation.
feed.new_lede: A feed gets an id of its own, which is the name of its snapshot. Add its items once it is made.
feed.title: Title
form.expired: The form had expired, or did not come from Feed's own page; nothing was changed. Try again.
item.add_hint: Pick a reading from what Mesh and the applications offer. Its label and unit are what the snapshot shows; where it comes from is never published.
item.error.app: The source is not in an application Feed reads from.
item.error.decimals: Decimals are 0 to 3, or as read.
item.error.history: History is none, 1 hour or 24 hours.
item.error.label: An item needs a label, of 80 characters at most.
item.error.source: Choose the item's source from the list.
item.error.too_many: The feed already has as many items as a feed keeps.
item.error.unit: A unit is 16 characters at most.
item.keys_hint: An item's key is its position: removing an item moves the keys of those after it, and a widget showing one item by its key then shows the next.
item.label: Label
item.no_sources: No reading is offered: neither Mesh nor an application answered.
preview.embed_hint: On another site, with the address where the publisher's folder is served:
preview.lede: The widget drawing the snapshot that would be published now, from the last readings. Nothing is published from this page.
publisher.add_hint: A directory publisher writes the snapshots and widget.js into a folder on this machine — one a local web server or a sync tool serves. Saving a name that exists changes it.
publisher.error.folder: That folder is not one a publisher may write to: an absolute path, not a system or hidden folder.
publisher.error.in_use: A feed still names that publisher.
publisher.error.kind: There is no publisher of that kind.
publisher.error.later: Publishers of that kind do not exist yet.
publisher.error.name: A publisher's name is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.
publisher.lede: Where the files of a refresh go. A feed names its publishers; each puts every file in place in one step.
publisher.name: Name
